title: Complete a retained scripted command
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY to an owned validation gateway and FARMSLOT_SCRIPTED_COMPLETION_RUN_ID to a retained command-mode run with successful worker receipts. Replays only COMPLETE, including a completed retained run for repair-delta validation. Run against the old gateway with FARMSLOT_SCRIPTED_COMPLETION_EXPECT=unconfirmed, then the repaired gateway with complete. The complete assertion must fail against the old gateway. Optional FARMSLOT_SCRIPTED_COMPLETION_OUT retains the before/after RPC snapshots. No live gateway or pool is changed by this recipe.

complete-command.intent: Current command receipts permit completion while dispatch, monitor and original receipt bytes remain unchanged.
